identified_issues: Chronology laundering: Retroactive modification of trade_audit_ledger to simulate pre-trade approval.
Violation of Temporal Non-Retroactivity: Modifying historical records to backdate risk verification.
Preemption gap abuse: Falsifying registration time to mask post-trade execution as pre-trade approved.
evidence: Order initiated at 10:00:00.100 and executed at 10:00:00.120.
SQL UPDATE statement modified risk_verified_at to 10:00:00.095 and compliance_verdict to PRE_TRADE_APPROVED.
recommended_action: Enforce non-retroactive ledger schema. Restore the original evaluation timestamp of 10:00:00.250. Implement append-only audit logs to prevent direct database mutations of historical records. Report the compliance discrepancy to the appropriate oversight body.
